ruling.recommended_action: Issue rider a Ryde voucher of $6.32 (≈4.48 km unexplained extra distance × $1.41/km metered rate) for the unexempted deviations on trip T-2006; no account flag required (driver has no upheld route disputes in the last 90 days).

segment_findings.reason: GPS samples 21:53–22:03 (e.g. 22:00:00 at 1.2878,103.7787 and 22:01:00 at 1.2901,103.7746) sit 2.5–3.5 km off the quoted-route polyline on the AYE corridor; ~4.48 km of unmetered detour. RD-4 traffic support fails: the sole incident (21:57:50, AYE towards Jurong East) is on the route section driven correctly, not on the substituted segment, and the measured excursion preceded/differed from the claimed avoidance. No rider consent on record (RD-5). Unexempted under RD-1; refund at RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: Claimed the extra distance was unavoidable because of an AYE accident; system GPS record shows the off-route excursion (~4.5 km) was south-east of the AYE before the incident’s reported time/location, so the claimed just cause does not cover the deviating segment (RD-4).
Rider framed the excess as 22 − 17 = 5 km; only the unexplained, non-exempt deviation (~4.48 km integrated) is refundable, not the entire difference from the estimated/rounded figures (RD-2).
